scientific_integrity: Finite incidence matrices and explicit optimum witnesses; no claim that computational experiments establish a general-length statement.
scientific_limitations: Binary codes, exactly one deletion, n<=7 only; upper bounds are verified with completed SciPy/HiGHS MIP, not an independently published solver-free search certificate. Two closely relevant 2026 sources were inspected in full official HTML, but earlier unindexed tables remain possible; the 2019 source was only partly accessible. Independent validation not performed.
title: Binary single-deletion list capacity through length seven and the first strict two-class size gap
